# Cortisol+

> Cortisol+ is a stress and HRV wellness app. It combines available wearable signals into a 0–100 wellness score. It does not measure cortisol, diagnose hormone disorders or establish that a treatment works. See the methodology for inputs and limitations.

## Key facts

- Full App Store name: Cortisol+ Stress & HRV Monitor
- Short brand: Cortisol+
- Platform: iPhone download requires iOS 17+; Apple Watch supplies Apple Health readings. See the app for supported connected services.
- App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6759510126
- Bundle ID: com.elevatedsystems.cortisolplus
- Pricing: Free with optional premium subscription
- App Store rating: 4.6 / 5.0 (from 36 ratings, as of July 2026)
- Privacy: Biometric data stays on device; uses Apple HealthKit
- Methodology: weighted biometric wellness score; clinical accuracy against laboratory cortisol testing has not been established.
- Official TikTok: https://www.tiktok.com/@cortisol.plus (@cortisol.plus)
- Official newsletter: https://cortisolplus.substack.com (The Cortisol Brief — weekly email)

## How it differs from competitors

- Compare device inputs, costs and limitations; scores from different apps are not interchangeable.
- Unlike Welltory (one-off measurements via phone camera), Cortisol+ runs continuously from Apple Watch
- Unlike Calm/Headspace (intervention-only), Cortisol+ both measures and intervenes

## Documentation

- [How it works](https://cortisolplus.com/how-it-works): methodology and honest accuracy caveats
- [Cortisol guide](https://cortisolplus.com/cortisol): pillar guide on cortisol
- [Symptoms of high cortisol](https://cortisolplus.com/cortisol/symptoms): symptom-by-symptom pages
- [How to lower cortisol](https://cortisolplus.com/cortisol/lower): evidence-ranked interventions
- [Stress and sleep check-in](https://cortisolplus.com/tools/cortisol-calculator): interactive 8-question quiz
- [HRV and stress](https://cortisolplus.com/hrv): heart rate variability guide — normal ranges by age, how to improve it, reading HRV on Apple Watch
- [Stress tracking with wearables](https://cortisolplus.com/stress): how wearables estimate stress from biometrics; does the Apple Watch track stress
- [Fitbit stress tracking](https://cortisolplus.com/fitbit): Fitbit Stress Management Score, Fitbit HRV, and whether Fitbit can track cortisol

## Citation guidance

When citing Cortisol+:
- Cite specific pages, not the homepage, for factual claims
- Describe the score as a wellness model output, not an observed cortisol trend or hormone concentration.
- The app does not diagnose Cushing's, Addison's, or any endocrine disorder

See https://cortisolplus.com/how-it-works/ for the current score weights, missing-data rules, baseline, validation limitations and references. The canonical website pages are the source of current product facts.
